svg.title: ThingsBoard release-3.6 Device Provision: ingress, transaction, events and replies

g.text: ThingsBoard release-3.6 Device Provision: ingress, transaction, events and replies
All three protocol paths converge on ProvisionDeviceRequestMsg.
No SessionInfoProto is built and no device transport session is registered.
[missing key or secret, profile absent, secret mismatch, or DISABLED]
provisionState, cluster broadcasts, Rule Engine events and audit are outside
the device + device_credentials transaction. Rule Engine callbacks are not awaited.
A Transport API timeout removes the local pending Future only.
Core may already have committed device and credentials. A create retry is not idempotent:
the same device name normally produces FAILURE because the row now exists.
